_meta.scope: key starting players for most teams; Canada + Switzerland carry their FULL starting XI for the 24 Jun 2026 Group B decider, with per-player detail (shots/SoT/key passes/pass accuracy) where sourceable.
_meta.split: wc = current World Cup 2026 matches; other = friendly + qualifier matches (kept separate)
_meta.fields: wc: matches, goals, assists, shots, shots_on_target, key_passes (chances created), pass_accuracy (%), note. Newer fields exist only on Canada/Switzerland entries.
_meta.sources: Goals: complete per-match scorer lists (NBC, ESPN, Sky Sports, Al Jazeera, FIFA, VAVEL). Per-player shots/passes: match reports + player-ratings pieces (SI, Sports Mole, Goal, Opta Analyst). Full per-player stat TABLES (Sofascore/FotMob/WhoScored/FBref) are JS-rendered and not fetchable, so granular shot/pass counts are only present where a report stated them.
_meta.confidence: goals: high (full scorer lists across all 4 Group B matches, so goals=0 is confirmed). assists/key_passes/shots/pass_accuracy: medium where a number is given, else null. IMPORTANT: for shots/passes, null = not reported (NOT zero) — no complete tables were available. matches = team WC matches played (2).
_meta.refresh: edit this file by hand from a stats source, then run `python src/scorers.py` to list what loaded and self-check the parlay blend.
